0: The pacman-sync CronJob pushes its run metrics to the Pushgateway in the observability namespace

set -u
PUSHGW="http://prometheus-pushgateway.observability.svc.cluster.local:9091/metrics/job/pacman-sync"
LOG=/tmp/rsync.log
START=$(date +%s)

# Upstream mirrors, tried in order until one completes a full pass.
# ftp.halifax.rwth-aachen.de is not used anymore: since 2026-10-29 it
# refuses rsync connections from this network (ECONNREFUSED on 873,
# while HTTPS on 443 to the same IP keeps working).
MIRRORS="rsync://frankfurt.mirror.pkgbuild.com/packages/
rsync://ftp.fau.de/archlinux/
rsync://mirror.ubrco.de/archlinux/"

RC=1
ATTEMPTS=0
USED=none
for MIRROR in $MIRRORS; do
  ATTEMPTS=$((ATTEMPTS + 1))
  echo "=== syncing from $MIRROR (attempt $ATTEMPTS)"

  # --exclude='.*' skips upstream's in-flight temp files (e.g.
  # .extra.files.tar.gz.dI031r), which are mode 0600 on the mirror
  # and make rsync fail with "Permission denied (13)" -> exit 23
  # whenever we sync while upstream is mid-update.
  # --delete-after keeps the tree consistent when an attempt dies
  # half-way and the next mirror takes over.
  rsync -rtlvH --safe-links --delete-after --delete-excluded \
    --delay-updates --no-motd --stats --itemize-changes \
    --timeout=300 --contimeout=20 \
    --exclude='.*' --exclude='iso/' --exclude='*-debug/' \
    --exclude='sources/' \
    "$MIRROR" /srv/repo/ >"$LOG" 2>&1
  RC=$?
  cat "$LOG"

  # rsync exit 24 = "some files vanished before they could be
  # transferred"; expected when mirroring an actively-updating
  # upstream repo. Treat as success.
  if [ "$RC" -eq 24 ]; then
    echo "rsync exit 24 (vanished source files) treated as success"
    RC=0
  fi

  if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then
    USED="$MIRROR"
    break
  fi
  echo "=== $MIRROR failed with rsync exit $RC, trying next mirror"
done

END=$(date +%s)
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && SUCCESS=1 || SUCCESS=0

parse_num() { grep -E "^$1:" "$LOG" | head -1 | sed -E 's/[^0-9]*([0-9,]+).*/\1/' | tr -d ','; }
FILES=$(parse_num 'Number of regular files transferred'); FILES=${FILES:-0}
DELETED=$(parse_num 'Number of deleted files'); DELETED=${DELETED:-0}
BYTES=$(parse_num 'Total transferred file size'); BYTES=${BYTES:-0}
RECEIVED=$(parse_num 'Total bytes received'); RECEIVED=${RECEIVED:-0}

cat <<EOF | curl -sf -X PUT --max-time 30 --data-binary @- "$PUSHGW" || echo "pushgateway push failed"
# TYPE pacman_sync_success gauge
pacman_sync_success $SUCCESS
# TYPE pacman_sync_duration_seconds gauge
pacman_sync_duration_seconds $((END - START))
# TYPE pacman_sync_files_transferred gauge
pacman_sync_files_transferred $FILES
# TYPE pacman_sync_files_deleted gauge
pacman_sync_files_deleted $DELETED
# TYPE pacman_sync_bytes_transferred gauge
pacman_sync_bytes_transferred $BYTES
# TYPE pacman_sync_bytes_received gauge
pacman_sync_bytes_received $RECEIVED
# TYPE pacman_sync_attempts gauge
pacman_sync_attempts $ATTEMPTS
# TYPE pacman_sync_upstream_info gauge
pacman_sync_upstream_info{mirror="$USED"} 1
EOF

exit $RC

mqtt:
  server: tcp://mosquitto.infrastructure.svc.cluster.local:1883
  topic_path: zigbee2mqtt/+
  qos: 0
cache:
  timeout: 24h
json_parsing:
  separator: .
metrics:
  # Température / humidité (capteurs)
  - prom_name: zigbee_temperature
    mqtt_name: temperature
    help: Temperature in Celsius
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_humidity
    mqtt_name: humidity
    help: Humidity in percent
    type: gauge
  # Batterie / santé du mesh
  - prom_name: zigbee_battery
    mqtt_name: battery
    help: Battery level in percent
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_voltage
    mqtt_name: voltage
    help: Battery voltage in millivolts
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_linkquality
    mqtt_name: linkquality
    help: Zigbee link quality (LQI)
    type: gauge
  # Prise connectée (SONOFF S60ZBTPF)
  - prom_name: zigbee_power
    mqtt_name: power
    help: Power consumption in watts
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_current
    mqtt_name: current
    help: Current in amperes
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_energy
    mqtt_name: energy
    help: Total energy consumption in kWh
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_energy_today
    mqtt_name: energy_today
    help: Energy consumed today in kWh
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_energy_yesterday
    mqtt_name: energy_yesterday
    help: Energy consumed yesterday in kWh
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_energy_month
    mqtt_name: energy_month
    help: Energy consumed this month in kWh
    type: gauge
  # Détecteurs de fumée
  - prom_name: zigbee_smoke_density
    mqtt_name: smoke_density
    help: Smoke density
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_power_outage_count
    mqtt_name: power_outage_count
    help: Number of power outages
    type: gauge
  # Compteur Linky (LiXee ZLinky_TIC)
  - prom_name: zigbee_apparent_power
    mqtt_name: apparent_power
    help: Apparent power in VA
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_current_summ_delivered
    mqtt_name: current_summ_delivered
    help: Total energy index (BASE) in kWh
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_rms_current
    mqtt_name: rms_current
    help: Instantaneous current in amperes
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_rms_current_max
    mqtt_name: rms_current_max
    help: Maximum current in amperes
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: zigbee_available_power
    mqtt_name: available_power
    help: Available subscribed power in kVA
    type: gauge

Batch jobs push their run metrics here; today that is the pacman-sync CronJob in the development namespace

PROFILE=/crawls/profiles/profile.tar.gz
NEW_PROFILE=/crawls/profiles/profile-new.tar.gz

mkdir -p /crawls/profiles
rm -f "$NEW_PROFILE"

if [ -s "$PROFILE" ]; then
  echo "Refreshing existing browser profile..."

  /docker-entrypoint.sh create-login-profile \
    --url https://forum.theonyxpath.com/ \
    --profile "$PROFILE" \
    --filename "$NEW_PROFILE"
else
  echo "Creating new browser profile..."

  /docker-entrypoint.sh create-login-profile \
    --url https://forum.theonyxpath.com/ \
    --filename "$NEW_PROFILE"
fi

test -s "$NEW_PROFILE"

mv -f "$NEW_PROFILE" "$PROFILE"
echo "Browser profile saved."

exec sleep infinity

PROFILE=/crawls/profiles/profile.tar.gz
COLLECTION=onyx-forums-full
COLLECTION_DIR="/crawls/collections/$COLLECTION"
STATE_DIR="$COLLECTION_DIR/crawls"

while [ ! -s "$PROFILE" ]; do
  echo "Waiting for browser profile..."
  sleep 10
done

echo "Browser profile ready."

set -- \
  --url https://forum.theonyxpath.com/ \
  --scopeType host \
  --exclude '^https?://forum\.theonyxpath\.com/(register|login|logout|lostpw|search|contact-us)([/?#]|$)' \
  --profile "$PROFILE" \
  --collection "$COLLECTION" \
  --workers 2 \
  --generateWACZ \
  --text to-pages \
  --saveState always \
  --saveStateInterval 900 \
  --saveStateHistory 10 \
  --logExcludeContext links

STATE=""
if [ -d "$STATE_DIR" ]; then
  STATE="$(find "$STATE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.yaml' |
    sort | tail -n 1)"
fi

if [ -n "$STATE" ]; then
  if [ -d "$COLLECTION_DIR/logs" ] &&
     grep -Rqs '"message":"Page Finished"' "$COLLECTION_DIR/logs"; then

    echo "Resuming crawl from: $STATE"
    set -- "$@" --config "$STATE"

  else
    echo "Previous crawl recorded no successful pages."
    echo "Preserving failed collection and starting fresh."

    BACKUP="${COLLECTION_DIR}.failed-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
    mv "$COLLECTION_DIR" "$BACKUP"
  fi
else
  echo "No checkpoint found. Starting fresh."
fi

echo "Starting Browsertrix..."
exec /docker-entrypoint.sh crawl "$@"
